description: Audit an ecommerce storefront for AI-agent shopping readiness. Fetches the store server-side and runs 20 weighted checks across product intelligence (schema.org Product/Offer price, availability, variants, GTIN/MPN), AI discovery (robots.txt, llms.txt, agents.md, sitemap.xml, UCP manifest, MCP endpoint), conversation readiness (contact info, FAQ/returns, site search), transaction readiness (HTTPS, checkout signals, tax/shipping as values), and trust (business identity, policies). Returns a machine-readable JSON report: 0-100 score, A-F grade, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, and the top 3 prioritized fixes. Cost: $1.00 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this to decide whether a store is ready for AI shopping agents, or to generate the audit behind a readiness report for a merchant.

url.description: Storefront URL to grade, e.g. https://example-store.com
